notes: Primary MD iMAP host geodata.md.gov returned 503 'Site Maintenance' on 2026-10-11; use mdgeodata.md.gov/imap/rest/services (identical paths, working).

Talbot County's own server gis.talbotdes.org (and map.talbotdes.org) timed out; the county's data is also published on ArcGIS Online org services6.arcgis.com/ScyqVZ3lUUihZ0ky (public, works) - source: web map e41dab3d32b2425fa25479c1d7a8a902 (Talbot County Land Use Basemap).
MDE has no public W&S plan service; only Talbot's own S-/W- category polygons were found. Other counties: check county GIS / MDP 'Sewer Service Areas' later.
Owner names are suppressed in the MDP/SDAT parcel layers; SDAT Socrata gives the prior-owner (grantor) and deed references.

layers.name: MD Parcel Boundaries (SDAT+MDP)
layers.key_fields: ACCTID (county2+district2+acct6), JURSCODE, ADDRESS, ACRES, LANDAREA, LU/DESCLU, ZONING, CRTARCOD, AGFNDAREA, OWNADD1/OWNCITY (mailing addr), LEGAL1-3, DR1LIBER/FOLIO, MAP/GRID/PARCEL/LOT, SUBDIVSN/PLAT, TRADATE/CONSIDR1, NFMTTLVL, SDATWEBADR
layers.date_info: SDATDATE=2026MAY (Talbot); no layer editing date; maxRecordCount 1000
layers.notes: NO owner-name field (hidden). SDAT ZONING is blank for ~88% of Talbot parcels and stale (A2 vs county AC) - do not rely on it. CRTARCOD also usually null; use Critical Area polygons. ACRES can be 0/null for lots; use LANDAREA/POLYACRES. Fields ending in 'ZONING' etc. same in Parcel Points layer (PropertyData/0).

layers.name: MD Property Data (parcel points)
layers.key_fields: same attributes as parcel polygons + DIGXCORD/DIGYCORD
layers.notes: Use for address/acct search by attribute (where=ACCTID='...'). Layers 1-2 = tax maps/grids.

layers.name: SDAT Real Property (Socrata, tabular)
layers.key_fields: jurisdiction_code_mdp_field_jurscode, account_id_mdp_field_acctid, real_property_search_link, legal_description_line_1..3, deed_reference_1_liber/folio, sales_segment_1..3 (grantor name, transfer date, consideration, mkt land/improvement value), current_assessment_year_total_assessment, premise address, land_use_code, zoning_code
layers.notes: 'Hidden owner names': current owner suppressed; prior owner = sales_segment_1 grantor. Gives deed liber/folio for land-records lookup and link to SDAT detail page. SoQL column names are the long ones shown. No API key needed (throttled w/o app token).

layers.name: Geocoder (address -> point; also by ACCTID)
layers.key_fields: SingleLine
layers.notes: Returns address-range and parcel-account candidates (score 100 both). Also GeocodeServices/MD_ParcelAccountNumberLocator.

layers.name: Talbot County parcels (TALBPOLY_2026FEB)
layers.key_fields: same schema as state parcels
layers.notes: Same schema, older SDAT vintage than state layer (Feb vs May 2026); county may carry newer polygons. Same zoning-field caveat.

layers.name: Talbot County zoning districts
layers.key_fields: Zoning2018 (RC, RR, WRC, AC, VM, VC, LC, GC, LI, TR, TC, VH, VR, CP, MUNI), LOCATION, Map_No, Acres
layers.notes: AUTHORITATIVE for unincorporated Talbot. Field is named Zoning2018 (code list predates later text amendments - verify against current code). Municipal land = MUNI/town zoning (Easton, St Michaels, Oxford, Trappe, Queenstown...) -> use town zoning or MDP generalized. Overlays: Airport (layer 28), Historical (21), Gateway (22).

layers.name: MDP Generalized Zoning 2025
layers.key_fields: GENZONE, JURSCODE, MUNICIPALITY_NAME, UPDATEYR, ACRES, ABBREVIATION
layers.notes: Statewide, includes municipalities (use for the other 8 counties as a first pass); categories only (e.g. RURAL LOW DENSITY RESIDENTIAL), not local district codes. Older: Generalized_Zoning MapServer.

layers.name: Critical Areas - Counties (IDA/LDA/RCA)
layers.publisher: DNR / MDP / CBCAC via MD iMAP
layers.key_fields: Type (IDA, LDA, RCA, WET, FED), CritArea, Location (county)
layers.notes: Classification is by polygon; 'WET'=tidal wetlands, 'FED'=federal. Example uses a Tilghman point (point 38.70,-76.05 is outside the Critical Area). Talbot has 327 polygons (7.5 MB). DNR interpretation - verify with county Critical Area map/Planning staff. Town polygons are layer 0 (Easton, St Michaels, Oxford...).

layers.name: Critical Area Towns
layers.key_fields: Type, CritArea, Town, County
layers.notes: Talbot: Easton, St. Michaels, Oxford, Queen Anne (50 polys).

layers.name: Talbot 1000-ft Critical Area line + Buffer Management Areas
layers.key_fields: TYPE (line only; no class)
layers.notes: Line only - cannot classify. Buffer_Management_Areas (layer 27; COMMUNITY, TaxMap, Setback) is county polygons.

layers.name: Priority Funding Areas
layers.key_fields: JURSCODE, CPFA, MUN_CODE, RUVI_CODE, RUVI_NAME, ACRES, CERT_DATE, STATE_ELIGIBLE_STATUS
layers.notes: Point must be inside a polygon (empty result = not in PFA). Example is Tilghman (rural village). Also a FeatureServer twin.

layers.name: SB 236 Septic Growth Tiers (state)
layers.key_fields: County, TIER (Tier 1, 1A, 2, 2A-C, 3A-C, 4), TIER_CODE, JURSCODE, MUNI, Adopt_Date, SRC_DATE, NOTE
layers.notes: Statewide uniform schema. Large vertex count (Talbot 18 MB). Tier IV = no major subdivision on septic (>=5 lots) under 2012 Sustainable Growth Act.

layers.name: Talbot septic tier / land use plan (Aug 2016)
layers.key_fields: SepticTier (Tier I-IV, II-A.., III-A..), Plan_Use, PlanMD, ZONE_06, TOWN
layers.notes: Local source of the state layer; includes a 'Tier T' value (meaning unverified).

layers.name: Talbot Sewer Service Area (S-1/S-2/S-3)
layers.key_fields: TYPE (S-1, S-2, S-3), Res_No, Date, ID
layers.notes: County W&S plan categories as GIS. No polygon = no planned public service (S-6/W-6 implied). No statewide W&S layer found: MDE ArcGIS (mdewin64.mde.state.md.us) folders MDE_WSP/MDE_Wastewater/WSIPS_PROD list no public services.

layers.name: Talbot Water Service Area (W-1/W-2/W-3)
layers.key_fields: TYPE (W-1..W-3), Res_No, Date
layers.notes: As above.

layers.name: Water Resource Areas (MDP Water Resource Elements)
layers.key_fields: CO, Status, WWR, WellHead, TierII, PresCons_T
layers.notes: County-level coarse; wellhead protection / Tier II stream flags. Not a service-area layer.

layers.name: DNR Wetlands (polygon)
layers.key_fields: Type (incl. Upland), Class
layers.notes: Includes 'Upland' polygons - treat Type='Upland' as no wetland. Layer 0 = linear DNR wetlands. Talbot county also hosts Talbot_DNR_Wetlands (FeatureServer/13).

layers.name: National Wetlands Inventory (state-hosted copy)
layers.key_fields: Wetland, Code (Cowardin), Legend, Decoder
layers.notes: Example point is open Chesapeake water. Do not bulk-download.

layers.name: NWI (USFWS direct)
layers.key_fields: ATTRIBUTE (Cowardin code), WETLAND_TYPE, ACRES
layers.date_info: maxRecordCount 500; currency per FWS Wetlands Data Layer
layers.notes: Responds; verified empty at test points and non-error. Most current federal source.

layers.name: Wetlands of Special State Concern (polygon / linear)
layers.key_fields: Type
layers.notes: Rare; Talbot envelope returned 17 polys (may include neighbors).

layers.name: FEMA NFHL - Flood Hazard Zones
layers.key_fields: FLD_ZONE (AE, VE, X, A, AO), ZONE_SUBTY, SFHA_TF, STATIC_BFE, V_DATUM, DFIRM_ID (Talbot 24041C)
layers.notes: Verified live. Layer 28 = flood hazard zones (other layers not verified). Coastal A (CoastalAE) appears via ZONE_SUBTY / LiMWA line; VE zone is FLD_ZONE='VE'. No result in Talbot = zone unmapped/outside SFHA polygon (X polygons exist in most mapped areas).

layers.name: MD Effective FEMA Floodplain (state copy)
layers.key_fields: FLD_ZONE, ZONE_SUBTY, SFHA_TF, STATIC_BFE, EFFECTIVE_DATE (e.g. 8/2013)
layers.notes: Backup to NFHL. Also Hydrology/MD_LiMWA (LiMWA line). Talbot hosts FEMA_Flood_Zones_2016/FeatureServer/24 and LiMWA_Revised/3 (downloaded limwa-line).

layers.name: NRCS SSURGO - Soil Data Access (SQL)
layers.key_fields: mapunit.muname/mukey, component.compname/comppct_r/drainagecl/hydricrating/hydgrp, cointerp.interphrc (rule 'ENG - Septic Tank Absorption Fields')
layers.notes: Verified. Septic rating classes: Not limited / Somewhat limited / Very limited (nearly all Talbot soils are 'Very limited' by NRCS rule - county perc tests govern). hydricrating Yes/No per component; weight by comppct_r. Spatial alt: Talbot Soils_2020/FeatureServer/14 (MUSYM, MUKEY) at Talbot GIS.

layers.name: MALPF easements
layers.key_fields: Loc_Nm, EsmtHldr, Date_Prot, GIS_Acres, Source_PAID, JURSCODE, Category
layers.notes: Test point is inside MALPF 'Blades' easement (279 ac).

layers.name: MET easements
layers.key_fields: Easement, COHOLD, METAcres, County

layers.name: Rural Legacy; DNR lands; Local protected; TDR/PDR; Forest Cons.; CELCP; Private conservation
layers.layer_id: 1 RL, 0 DNR, 5 local, 9 TDR/PDR, 3 FCA, 6 CELCP, 7 private
layers.key_fields: RLArea/County; DNRType/DNRName; Loc_Nm/EsmtHldr/JURSCODE
layers.notes: Query each layer id separately.

layers.name: Priority Preservation Areas
layers.key_fields: JURSCODE, AREA_NAME, Certified, GIS_Acres

layers.name: Talbot Protected Lands 2026
layers.key_fields: EasementHolder, GISAcres, PPA (YES/NO), ApprovalNumber
layers.notes: Most current/complete for Talbot (all holders incl. Eastern Shore Land Conservancy).

layers.name: Maryland Green Infrastructure (hubs/corridors/gaps)
layers.key_fields: HC_Type (Hub/Corridor/Gap), Area_acres
layers.notes: Relevant to Forest Conservation Act/ mitigation. Also Biota/MD_Forests (0 Forests of Recognized Importance, 1 Forested Buffers). Not downloaded (large).

layers.name: CoastSmart CRAB flood depth + SLAMM 2050
layers.key_fields: Classify.Pixel Value (ft depth), Class value
layers.notes: Use identify (rasters). SLAMM2050: Environment/MD_CoastalFloodSLAMM2050/MapServer layer 1 (class value codes). Verified both return pixel values. Also FFRMS ImageServers.

layers.name: Municipal boundaries (detailed)
layers.key_fields: MUN_NAME, JURSCODE, MUN_CODE, ANNEXATION_DATE, RESOLUTION_NUMBER, ACRES
layers.notes: County boundaries = layer 1 (COUNTY, COUNTYNUM). Talbot hosts Talbot_Municipal_Boundary/12 (5 towns).

layers.name: Road centerlines
layers.publisher: MDOT SHA via iMAP; Talbot County
layers.key_fields: COUNTY, ROADNAMESHA, ROUTEID (state); county layer: full_stnam, roadclass, speedlimit, sha_type
layers.notes: Talbot county layer: Road_Centerlines_0716/FeatureServer/0 (4,079 segs, downloaded). Also Transportation/MD_AnnualAverageDailyTraffic.

layers.name: Talbot address points; building footprints; sewer/water infrastructure
layers.key_fields: fulladdress, add_number, street, post_comm, latitude, longitude
layers.notes: Building_Footprint (26), Out_Building_Footprint (18), Driveways (4) in same org. Public sewer/water INFRASTRUCTURE (pipes/plants) NOT found public.
